none: PAS NCL-7CCD42: NCL-7CCD42: Roman lead sealing
contea di ritrovamento: Darlington (Inghilterra e Galles)

A lead sealing, probably military, dating to the Roman period. The sealing is oval in shape and hemispherical in section. The obverse has a stamped oval die, within which is the legend 'G'EP'S' ​G(aius) Ep(...) S(...) in relief.
